correctness.rationale: For any finite elementary abelian 2-group of size 2^d, q arbitrary, and an exchangeable full data null with a.s. distinct orbit scores, partition three iid transformation draws by equality pattern. Conditional on all-distinct draw labels, observed score rank is uniform; two-equal pair comparisons are fair by involution symmetry; all-equal produces p=1. This yields masses in s2 and s3. Pairwise Robin-Hood transfers increase both nontrivial CDF thresholds strictly, showing unique uniform extremality. Independent exact rational orbit enumeration for all 24 strict score orders on the four-element group agreed with the moment law; the two specified three-resample orders give different exact histograms.
residual_risks: Finite independent experiments corroborate selected identities only; universal assertions depend on reconstructed proof, not experiments.
